clips.why: AI plays snake locally, 30 decisions a second, never fails; then what a System 1 model is. Two defensible endings: after the snake beat (27.8) or after the explanation (56-68).
Since the launch people have built: Mario, lead scoring, a flight booked in 7s for $0.0039.
Running an open-weights model locally is cooler; Claude Code ported the demo to it in one session.
Hot take: three years in stealth, cloned in five days; it is not going to be closed source any more. Best clip in the video.
System 1 vs System 2, Thinking Fast and Slow, LLMs can't count the Rs. The whole stretch is ~104s, over the 75s band; 469-537 is the tight cut.

negatives.why: Live browser-agent demos ('watch this, it's gonna be so fast'): the point is on screen, not in the words.
Sandwich / email playground walkthrough: narrates UI the viewer cannot see ('these are the results in here'). Emphatic numbers, no standalone point.
